atoms.name: DFA reading
atoms.one_line: One move per state and symbol; a string is accepted if its single run ends in a final state.

atoms.name: NFA and ε-NFA
atoms.one_line: Accept if some path ends final; ε-closure after every step.

atoms.name: Subset construction
atoms.one_line: DFA states are sets of NFA states: at most 2^n, only reachable ones count.

atoms.name: Minimal DFA and counting states
atoms.one_line: Merge states with equal futures; ends-with k needs k+1, counters multiply, a dead state counts.

atoms.name: DFA to regex
atoms.one_line: Describe the language in words, then use loops and exits (state elimination).

atoms.name: Equivalence and witnesses
atoms.one_line: Two regexes or DFAs differ if one short string separates them.

atoms.name: Closure properties
atoms.one_line: Union, intersection, complement, reversal, concatenation and star keep regularity; infinite unions do not.

atoms.name: Product construction
atoms.one_line: Run two DFAs together; states are pairs, finals follow the operation.

atoms.name: Counting accepted strings
atoms.one_line: Propagate counts per state, or sum binomials for counter conditions.
